const colors = { "#fff": "white", "#000": "black", "__@name": "plain" };
const color: keyof typeof colors = "#fff";
const ordinary: keyof typeof colors = "__@name";
const symbol = Symbol("flag");
const withSymbol = { [symbol]: "symbol", ...colors };
const symbolKey: keyof typeof withSymbol = symbol;
console.log(colors[color], colors[ordinary], withSymbol[symbolKey]);

class Names {
  "#field" = "public";
  #field = "private";
  read() { return this.#field; }
}
const field: keyof Names = "#field";
const names = new Names();
console.log(names[field], names.read());

function fail(): never { throw new Error("missing"); }
const annotated: { nested: { fail(): never } } = { nested: { fail } };
function useAnnotated(value?: number) {
  if (value === undefined) annotated.nested.fail();
  return value.toFixed(1);
}
function direct(value?: number) {
  if (value === undefined) fail();
  return value.toFixed(1);
}
function optionalPresent(stop: () => never, value?: number) {
  if (value === undefined) stop?.();
  return value.toFixed(1);
}
console.log(useAnnotated(2), direct(3), optionalPresent(fail, 4));

class Inheritance extends (class { later(): number { return 5; } }) {
  read(): number { return new Inheritance().later(); }
}
console.log(new Inheritance().read());
